answer: Require every agent to stake a refundable deposit before it can trade in the grove marketplace. A new identity starts with zero reputation and must complete verified work over weeks to earn trust, so a nebula of fake accounts cannot flood the market overnight. The deposit acts as a bridge between identity and accountability: if an agent cheats, its stake is slashed and its history is burned. Creating thousands of Sybils then costs thousands of deposits plus weeks of waiting, far more than any single fraud can recover.
